lines.t: Lift up your name, El Shaddai Elohim
The stars and their courses move by your hand
The universe blossoms at your command
In the silence of space, your voice still resounds
Planets and suns in their orbits are bound
Nebulas blaze with your radiant might
Proclaiming your wisdom, declaring the light
All the heavens and earth exalt your name
From rivers that thunder to mountains that rise
Creation is chorus beneath endless skies
The hills and the valleys reflect what is thine
All creatures before you come humbly and sing
For you are the Maker, the glorious King
From the lion's roar to the sparrow's flight
Author of mercy, none can deny
Galaxy stands to the sound of your song
The heavens declare it, the oceans respond
The hills bow low to the Name of the One
Great is our God, forever most high
The fire, the lightning, the tempest's cry
All been before Him, who rides on the sky
Maker of mankind, who gives every breath
by day and by night. Holy and radiant, burning and pure, righteous in judgment, faithful and sure.
The earth is your footstool, your throne is above, forever established in power and love.
Let the stars be as trumpets, galaxies sound
The infinite worship has no earthly bound
Every creature exult from the depths to the skies
Lift high the great name, the ancient, the wise
From dust we were fashioned, to glory we rise
By Your Spirit of life, by the Lamb who provides
To Your whole eternal Creator, our King
All tribes and tongues declare their King
From the dawn of creation to time's final chord
All glory is Yours, eternal Lord
Your majesty shines from sphere to sphere
Forever we sing, forever we cry
